behavior.entry: 任务复盘 → 候选优化与发布 → AI 自动整理
behavior.trigger: After a new terminal-task rule review is saved, analyze complete evidence with cited findings. Existing historical reports before feature activation are not bulk-analyzed. Pending evidence is retained by project; an existing candidate defers processing.
behavior.ownership: Event-driven workflow owned and aborted by the existing project conversation scope. Uses an isolated current-backend/current-model analysis turn, shared bounded analysis transport and existing accounting contracts. No editor mutation tools, code edits or automatic publication.
behavior.output: At most three candidate-only advice entries, applicability, keywords, original review/finding references and positive/negative matching cases. Atomic candidate commit; current state and source library revisions checked. Existing regression expectations are preserved. Empty suggestions are supported.
behavior.persistence: Project journal stores activation boundary, durable per-evidence attempt status, structured suggestion artifacts and independent accounting. Restart/discard cannot silently retry the same task revision and evidence digest. Backlog retains only artifact references, hydrates one report at a time, and skips already-attempted evidence.
behavior.lifecycle: New task dispatch, manual deep review, cancellation, project switch and disposal cancel background analysis. Late results cannot replace user candidates or activate advice. Published AI-only advice remains editable, disableable and archivable through the existing workflow.
limitations: Uses current model quota. Per-request backends enforce hard output limits; other backends retain single-turn/time bounds and report the missing hard output cap.
Generated suggestions and test cases require human review and offline validation before publication; matching validation is not proof of real-task quality improvement.
No automatic retry on identical evidence after failure, cancellation or restart. Missing or partial evidence does not produce candidates.
Deterministic fake-backend and isolated Electron fixtures verify behavior; no live paid-provider quality benchmark was run.

secretScan.limitation: Pattern and configured-value scan of generated files; no real credential store is read. A zero crash-dump count means no dump was generated.
